mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year increase in CPIAUCSL above 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers hawkish monetary policy expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors price in tighter financial conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates robust aggregate demand, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where both HOUST and RSAFS show positive year-over-year growth.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market with unemployment rate below 4.0% and strong job growth (PAYEMS > 100k monthly), the risk of overheating triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months meeting the trigger condition (UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS > 100).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (base 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months where INDPRO falls below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) over the past month indicates strong housing market activity, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where HOUST increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months where UNRATE rises by more than 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) and stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS >= 4.0%) indicates a hawkish monetary policy stance that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS >= 4.0%.
